# Evidence boundary — CHIMERA / HAR / QEGT

Record: `CITY-APP-CHIMERA-20260915`
Machine run: `CHIMERA-QEGT-HAR-20260915`

Three classes. No promotion across classes.

## Established (HAR biology)

Supported by the cited literature. Catalog size is definition-dependent; functional studies interrogate **~2,600–3,100** loci, not a rounded “~3,000”. Whalen et al. 2023: ~96% noncoding in that set; 31% enhancer-active in human/chimp NPCs; **43%** contain human variants with large opposing chromatin-state effects; **14%** with opposing neurodevelopmental enhancer effects.

Named anchors include Pollard 2006 (HAR1), Boyd 2015 (HARE5/FZD8), Girskis 2021 (PPP1R17), Cui 2025 (HAR202/NPAS3; 2xHAR.319/PUM2; HAR26), Pal 2025 (HAR–target contacts), Mosti 2026 (HAR1984).

Not claimed: a single cognition gene; an unsourced “186 societies” figure; a personal-genotype walkthrough.

## Machine verified (E47 + Gibbs)

E47 is reconstructed from spin-2 SU(2) generators on \(V_2^{\otimes 3}\) (\(\dim=125\)), \(K=(C-6I)(C-30I)\), \(\dim\ker K=47\), \(\Omega_c=47/125\), \(\rho_\perp=15/17\) at \(\varepsilon_*=1/99144\).

Gibbs/softmax \(p(\omega)=\exp(-\beta C)/Z\) is a **statistical operator**. A physical-quantum implementation requires an explicit Hilbert space, observable or channel, preparation, and measurement. That is not assumed.

Projected Gibbs uniqueness on an allowed subspace is a separate machine record (`PGT-E47-20260731`). \(P_{\mathrm{dev}}\) is **not** identified with \(P_{47}\).

## Hypothesis (HAR → QEGT)

Typed translation chain, every arrow rejectable:

\[
S_{\mathrm{HAR}}\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{cis}}}G_{\mathrm{dev}}\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{op}}}H_{\mathrm{dev}}(h,t)\xrightarrow{G_\beta}\rho_*(h,t)\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{pheno}}}Y
\]

Synthetic operators \(B_i\) in the witness are mixed-sign **demonstrators** (`SYNTHETIC_BRIDGE_DEMO_ONLY`). They are not biological effect sizes.

H1–H5 (distributed-operator, compensatory-curvature, 3D-topology, threshold-emergence, cross-species transport) are the rejection surface. H4 forbids pasting 47/125 onto a fitted developmental threshold.

## Six-cluster taxonomy

The atlas’s six-cluster grouping is a **model**, not a consensus biological partition.

## Visual system

Near-black laboratory. Cyan live · bronze Λ-ghost · mint lock. No type on stills. Record: `CITY-LABS-VISUAL-SYSTEM-20260915`.

files.content:
# CHIMERA — scientist edition

Dual-register instrument. Field copy lives in `GENERAL_AUDIENCE.md`. This page is the formal register.

## HAR biology (established)

HARs: conserved mammalian sequence with a human-lineage substitution burst. Catalog size is definition-dependent; major functional studies interrogate ~2,600–3,100 loci (Whalen et al. *Neuron* 2023: 2,645 HARs; ~96% noncoding; 31% enhancer-active in human/chimp NPCs; 43% opposing chromatin-state effects; 14% opposing neurodevelopmental enhancer effects). Same sequence in human vs chimp cells: activity highly similar ⇒ divergence is largely cis.

Anchors:

- Pollard et al. *Nature* 2006: HAR1/HAR1F in Cajal–Retzius neurons, GW ~7–19, coexpressed with reelin.
- Boyd et al. *Curr Biol* 2015: human HARE5 contacts FZD8; accelerated progenitor cycling and increased brain size vs chimpanzee ortholog in transgenic mice.
- Girskis et al. 2021: PPP1R17 HAR.
- Pal et al. *Cell* 2025: 1,590 HARs → 2,963 neurodevelopmental targets.
- Cui et al. *Nature* 2025: HAR202 attenuates NPAS3; 2xHAR.319→PUM2; HAR26/2xHAR.178→SOCS2/neurites.
- Mosti et al. *Cell Stem Cell* 2026: HAR1984 species-specific chromatin architecture, ETV5/TRA2B contacts, opposite neurogenesis direction on human↔chimp organoid swaps.

## QEGT statistical operator (machine / structural)

\[
p(\omega\mid h)=\frac{\exp[-\beta C(\omega\mid h)]}{Z},\qquad
C(\omega\mid h)=\langle\omega,H_{\mathrm{dev}}(h)\,\omega\rangle+\gamma R(\omega)
\]

\[
H_{\mathrm{dev}}(h)=H_0+\sum_i h_i B_i+\cdots
\]

Gibbs is a statistical operator. Physical-quantum status requires Hilbert space, observable/channel, preparation, measurement. Formalism Registry: **FRM-38** QEGT–ETNS Gibbs Strategy Selection.

Projected Gibbs on an allowed subspace: \([P,H]=0\), \(\rho_*=P e^{-\beta H}P/\mathrm{Tr}(P e^{-\beta H})\), uniqueness via \(F(\rho)-F(\rho_*)=\beta^{-1}D(\rho\|\rho_*)\). Certificate `PGT-E47-20260731`.

## Canonical E47 (machine reconstructed)

\[
V=V_2^{\otimes 3},\quad \dim V=125,\quad C=J_{\mathrm{tot}}^2,\quad
K=(C-6I)(C-30I)
\]

\[
E_{47}=\ker K=E_6\oplus E_{30},\quad \dim E_{47}=47,\quad
\Omega_c=\frac{\mathrm{Tr}P_{47}}{125}=\frac{47}{125}
\]

\[
\Gamma_\varepsilon=I-\varepsilon K^2,\qquad \varepsilon_*=1/99144,\qquad \rho_\perp=15/17
\]

Witness `python/qegt_har_bridge.py` reconstructs this from spin-2 SU(2) generators (not a rank-prescribed random kernel). Run `CHIMERA-QEGT-HAR-20260915` status PASS.

\(P_{\mathrm{dev}}\) is not identified with \(P_{47}\). 47/125 is not a fitted biological constant.

## Typed bridge (hypothesis)

\[
S_{\mathrm{HAR}}\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{cis}}}G_{\mathrm{dev}}\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{op}}}H_{\mathrm{dev}}(h,t)\xrightarrow{G_\beta}\rho_*(h,t)\xrightarrow{\varphi_{\mathrm{pheno}}}Y
\]

No equality of spaces. \(B_i\) estimated from HAR sequence swaps (CRISPR/prime editing) plus scRNA, scATAC, 3D contacts. Synthetic \(B_i\) in the witness are `SYNTHETIC_BRIDGE_DEMO_ONLY`.

### Rejection surface

| ID | Claim |
|---|---|
| H1 | Multi-HAR operator ensemble predicts cell-state transitions better than one-HAR baselines after complexity control |
| H2 | Compensatory HARs have larger Hessian/interaction terms than matched controls |
| H3 | Contact-changing swaps shift operator spectra beyond amplitude |
| H4 | A data-derived \(Q_{\mathrm{dev}}\) may cross a fitted \(Q_c\) — **not** 47/125 |
| H5 | Parameters transport to held-out human↔chimp swaps |

Failure of predictive transport rejects the parametrization.

## Six-cluster taxonomy

A model used by the atlas UI. Not a consensus biological partition.

files.title: GENERAL_AUDIENCE.md
files.content:
# CHIMERA — a walk for anyone

The Chimera is one named whole made of unlike parts. That image is older than genetics. This atlas uses it as a *register*, not a proof: mixed identity is something a culture can hold, and something a body can literally be, and something a genome’s control layer can look like.

## What HARs are

After the human lineage split from other apes, some stretches of DNA that had sat almost still for ages suddenly changed. Most of those stretches do not make proteins. They are switches — they time when, where, and how hard other genes are used. Human-ness, in this picture, is a rewritten mixing board, not a new list of parts.

Catalogs used in functional work hold on the order of **2,600–3,100** such stretches. About **96%** of one large tested set do not code for protein.

## Two early anchors

HAR1 is an RNA that turns on in the cells that first map the fetal cortex. HARE5 is a switch for a Wnt receptor; the human version, placed in a mouse, makes neural stem cells divide a little faster and the cortex a little larger. These are timed controls, not mysteries.

## The compensation surprise

Inside a single accelerated stretch, one human letter can push a switch up while another pushes it down. The circuit still works. Local fights, global tune. In one 2023 study, **43%** of tested HARs showed large opposing chromatin effects; **14%** showed opposing enhancer effects in neurodevelopment.

## Contacts, not only volume

A switch can change who it sits next to when the chromosome folds. Mapped HAR contacts, CRISPR edits, and a human enhancer (HAR1984) that rewires loops and changes how many neurons an organoid makes — in opposite directions when you swap human and chimpanzee letters — are now on the record.

## What the math is allowed to say

Imagine every possible way a developing cortex could run as a strategy with a cost. Cheaper strategies get more weight. That weighting is a softmax, a statistical mixing law. HARs, *in this model*, do not flip a cognition switch — they tilt the landscape those strategies live on. Whether biology uses that law is the question, not the premise.

A 125-dimensional spin construction has a 47-dimensional keep-set. **47/125 is exact there.** That number is a property of that algebra. It is not a brain threshold.

## The honest chain

Sequence → regulatory network → operator → strategy weights → measurable traits. Each arrow can fail on its own. If a bag of HAR switches does not predict cell-state changes better than simpler models, the bridge falls. If a learned threshold locks to 47/125 by construction, we refuse that as biology.

Download the Python witness. Break it. Replace the fake HAR sliders with real measurements.

files.content:
# CHIMERA — HAR Codex / QEGT Bridge

Permanent Mini AI Labs source under [E47-Kartekeya](https://github.com/nicholaskouns-create/E47-Kartekeya). Dual-register educational atlas of **established HAR biology**, **machine-verified E47 + Gibbs**, and a **typed, rejectable HAR → QEGT hypothesis**.

This folder is instrument **12 · CHIMERA · catalog**. It does **not** promote 47/125 as a biological cognition threshold. It does **not** claim HAR biology is a quantum game. Gibbs is a statistical operator first.

| Record | Value |
|---|---|
| Integration | `CITY-APP-CHIMERA-20260915` |
| Machine run | `CHIMERA-QEGT-HAR-20260915` |
| Projected Gibbs | `PGT-E47-20260731` |
| Visual system | `CITY-LABS-VISUAL-SYSTEM-20260915` |
| Drive | [12 — CHIMERA — HAR Codex](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Hc0HjHFwDNxiu7nR3gUKt8DYbtlCIqd-) |
| License | CC0 1.0 (same as this repository) |

## Evidence classes (kept separate)

| Class | What it covers | What it does not |
|---|---|---|
| **Established** | HAR catalogs, compensatory cis-regulation, 3D-contact rewiring, named loci (HAR1, HARE5, HAR1984, …) | A cognition gene; a 47/125 brain threshold |
| **Machine verified** | E47 reconstruction from spin-2 SU(2) on \(V_2^{\otimes 3}\); Gibbs/softmax normalization; projected-Gibbs uniqueness on an allowed subspace | A physical-quantum implementation; fitted biological operators |
| **Hypothesis** | HAR sequence → GRN → operator \(H_{\mathrm{dev}}(h)\) → Gibbs weights → phenotype. Each arrow is independently rejectable | Equality of spaces; synthetic \(B_i\) as effect sizes |

The 47/125 quantity is the exact E47 invariant \(\Omega_c=\mathrm{Tr}P_{47}/125\). It is not transported onto development unless an encoder is independently derived.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r chimera/requirements.txt
python3 chimera/python/qegt_har_bridge.py
```

Expected: JSON with `"status": "PASS"` and `"har_demo.status": "SYNTHETIC_BRIDGE_DEMO_ONLY"`.

## Layout

```
chimera/python/qegt_har_bridge.py
chimera/certificates/CHIMERA-QEGT-HAR-20260915.json
chimera/docs/GENERAL_AUDIENCE.md
chimera/docs/SCIENTIST_EDITION.md
chimera/docs/EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY.md

```

Canonical E47 kernel code remains at the repository root (`src/e47/`). CHIMERA is a catalog / evidence-boundary instrument, not an Octet packet stage.
